032        public static enum FragmentBehaviorOnImpact {
033                STOP_AND_FADE,
034                STOP_AND_FLASH,
035                KEEP_GOING,
036        }

048
049        @Override
050        public void advance(float amount, CombatEngineAPI engine, WeaponAPI weapon) {
051                ShipAPI ship = weapon.getShip();
052                if (ship == null) return;
053                
054                RoilingSwarmEffect swarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(ship);
055                if (swarm instanceof DwellerShroud) swarm = null;
056                int active = swarm == null ? 0 : swarm.getNumActiveMembers();
057                int required = getNumFragmentsToFire();
058                boolean disable = active < required;
059                weapon.setForceDisabled(disable);
060                
061                showNoFragmentSwarmWarning(weapon, ship);
062        }
063        
064        
065        public void onFire(DamagingProjectileAPI projectile, WeaponAPI weapon, CombatEngineAPI engine) {
066                this.projectile = projectile;
067                this.weapon = weapon;
068                this.engine = engine;
069                
070                if (!(projectile instanceof MissileAPI)) {
071                        engine.removeEntity(projectile);
072                        return;
073                }
074                missile = (MissileAPI) projectile;
075                if (missile.getSource() == null) {
076                        engine.removeEntity(projectile);
077                        return;
078                }
079                
080                ship = missile.getSource();
081                sourceSwarm = RoilingSwarmEffect.getSwarmFor(missile.getSource());
082                if (sourceSwarm == null) {
083                        engine.removeEntity(projectile);
084                        return;
085                }
086                
087                missile.setEmpResistance(getEMPResistance());
088
089                SwarmMember fragment = pickPrimaryFragment();
090                if (fragment == null) {
091                        engine.removeEntity(projectile);
092                        return;
093                }
094                
095                if (missile.getWeapon() == null || !missile.getWeapon().hasAIHint(AIHints.RANGE_FROM_SHIP_RADIUS)) {
096                        missile.setStart(new Vector2f(missile.getLocation()));
097                }
098                missile.getLocation().set(fragment.loc);
099                
100                // picked fragment with velocity closest to that of missile, leave the missile's velocity as is
101                if (!shouldPickVelocityMatchingPrimaryFragment()) {
102                        missile.getVelocity().set(fragment.vel);
103                        boolean setFacing = false;
104                        if (shouldMakeMissileFaceTargetOnSpawnIfAny()) {
105                                if (missile.getAI() instanceof GuidedMissileAI) {
106                                        GuidedMissileAI ai = (GuidedMissileAI) missile.getAI();
107                                        if (ai.getTarget() != null) {
108                                                missile.setFacing(Misc.getAngleInDegrees(fragment.loc, ai.getTarget().getLocation()));
109                                                setFacing = true;
110                                        }
111                                }
112                        }
113                        if (!setFacing && fragment.vel.length() > 0.1f) {
114                                missile.setFacing(Misc.getAngleInDegrees(fragment.vel));
115                        }
116                }
117                
118                RoilingSwarmParams params = new RoilingSwarmParams();
119                params.despawnSound = null;
120                params.maxSpeed = missile.getMaxSpeed() + 100f;
121                params.baseMembersToMaintain = 0;
122                params.removeMembersAboveMaintainLevel = false;
123                params.keepProxBasedScaleForAllMembers = true;
124                params.initialMembers = 0;
125                params.maxOffset = missile.getCollisionRadius() * 1.5f;
126                
127                configureMissileSwarmParams(params);
128                
129                // can't use data members inside the anon class since they'll change when it fires again
130                MissileAPI missile2 = missile;
131                FragmentBehaviorOnImpact behavior = getOtherFragmentBehaviorOnImpact();
132                boolean explodeOnFizzling = explodeOnFizzling();
133                String explosionSoundId = getExplosionSoundId();
134                RoilingSwarmEffect missileSwarm = new RoilingSwarmEffect(missile2, params) {
135                        boolean exploded = false;
136                        Set<SwarmMember> stopped = new LinkedHashSet<>();
137                        int origMembers = 0;
138                        boolean inited = false;
139                        @Override
140                        public void advance(float amount) {
141                                super.advance(amount);
142                                //if (true) return;
143                                
144                                if (removeFragmentsWhenMissileLosesHitpoints() && !missile2.didDamage()) {
145                                        if (!inited) {
146                                                origMembers = members.size();
147                                                inited = true;
148                                        }
149                                        if (origMembers > 0 && members.size() > 1 && missile2.getMaxHitpoints() > 0) {
150                                                float max = missile2.getMaxHitpoints();
151                                                float hpPerMember = max / origMembers; 
152                                                float hpLost = max - missile2.getHitpoints();
153                                                int loseMembers = (int) (hpLost / hpPerMember);
154                                                int num = members.size();
155                                                int alreadyLost = origMembers - num;
156                                                for (SwarmMember p : members) {
157                                                        if (p.fader.isFadingOut()) {
158                                                                alreadyLost++;
159                                                        }
160                                                }
161                                                int lose = loseMembers - alreadyLost;
162                                                if (lose > 0) {
163                                                        despawnMembers(lose, false);
164                                                }
165                                        }
166                                }
167                                
168                                fragment.loc.set(missile2.getLocation());
169                                fragment.vel.set(missile2.getVelocity());
170                                if (missile2.isFizzling() && engine.isMissileAlive(missile2)) {
171                                        fragment.fader.setBrightness(missile2.getCurrentBaseAlpha());
172                                }
173                                if (missile2.didDamage()) {
174                                        if (behavior != FragmentBehaviorOnImpact.KEEP_GOING) {
175                                                CombatEntityAPI target = null;
176                                                if (missile2.getDamageTarget() instanceof CombatEntityAPI) {
177                                                        target = (CombatEntityAPI) missile2.getDamageTarget();
178                                                }
179                                                for (SwarmMember p : members) {
180                                                        if (p == fragment || stopped.contains(p)) {
181                                                                if (p == fragment) {
182                                                                        //p.fader.setDurationOut(0.5f);
183                                                                }
184                                                                continue;
185                                                        }
186                                                        boolean hit = false;
187                                                        if (target != null && target.getExactBounds() != null) {
188                                                                if (target instanceof ShipAPI) {
189                                                                        ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI) target;
190                                                                        if (ship.getShield() != null) {
191                                                                                boolean inArc = ship.getShield().isWithinArc(p.loc);
192                                                                                if (inArc) {
193                                                                                        hit = Misc.getDistance(p.loc, ship.getShieldCenterEvenIfNoShield()) < 
194                                                                                                        ship.getShieldRadiusEvenIfNoShield();
195                                                                                }
196                                                                        }
197                                                                }
198                                                                if (!hit) {
199                                                                        hit = target.isPointInBounds(p.loc);
200                                                                }
201                                                        } else {
202                                                                Vector2f toP = Vector2f.sub(p.loc, fragment.loc, new Vector2f());
203                                                                hit = Vector2f.dot(toP, fragment.vel) > 0;
204                                                        }
205                                                        if (hit) {
206                                                                p.vel.set(new Vector2f());
207                                                                if (behavior == FragmentBehaviorOnImpact.STOP_AND_FLASH) {
208                                                                        p.flash();
209                                                                }
210                                                                reportFragmentHit(missile2, p, this, target);
211                                                                stopped.add(p);
212                                                        }
213                                                }
214                                        }
215                                }
216                                if (explodeOnFizzling && explosionSoundId != null) {
217                                        if ((missile2.isFizzling() || (missile2.getHitpoints() <= 0 && !missile2.didDamage())) && !exploded) {
218                                                exploded = true;
219                                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound(explosionSoundId, 1f, 1f, missile2.getLocation(), missile2.getVelocity());
220                                                missile2.interruptContrail();
221                                                engine.removeEntity(missile2);
222                                                missile2.explode();
223                                        }
224                                }
225                                
226                                if ((missile2.isFizzling() || missile2.getHitpoints() <= 0) && !missile2.didDamage() && !exploded) {
227                                        params.minDespawnTime = 0.5f;
228                                        params.maxDespawnTime = 1f;
229                                        params.minFadeoutTime = 0.5f;
230                                        params.maxFadeoutTime = 1f;
231                                        setForceDespawn(true);
232                                }
233                                
234                                swarmAdvance(amount, missile2, this);
235                        }
236                        
237//                      @Override
238//                      public int getNumMembersToMaintain() {
239//                              int base = params.baseMembersToMaintain;
240//                              float level = missile2.getHullLevel();
241//                              int maintain = (int) Math.round(level * base); 
242//                              if (maintain < 1) maintain = 1;
243//                              return maintain;
244//                      }
245                };
246                
247                sourceSwarm.removeMember(fragment);
248                missileSwarm.addMember(fragment);
249                fragment.rollOffset(missileSwarm.params, missile);
250                
251                if (makePrimaryFragmentGlow()) {
252                        if (fragment.flash != null) {
253                                fragment.flash = null;
254                        }
255                        fragment.flashNext = null;
256                        
257                        fragment.flash();
258                        fragment.flash.setBounceDown(false);
259                }
260                
261                
262                int transfer = getNumOtherMembersToTransfer();
263                if (transfer > 0) {
264                        sourceSwarm.transferMembersTo(missileSwarm, transfer, fragment.loc, getRangeForNearbyFragments());
265                }
266                
267                int add = getNumOtherMembersToAdd();
268                if (addNewMembersIfNotEnoughToTransfer() && missileSwarm.members.size() - 1 < transfer) {
269                        add += transfer - (missileSwarm.members.size() - 1);
270                }
271                if (add > 0) {
272                        missileSwarm.addMembers(add);
273                }
274                
275                swarmCreated(missile, missileSwarm, sourceSwarm);
276                
277                float hpLoss = getHPLossPerTransferredMember();
278                hpLoss *= 1 + transfer;
279                if (hpLoss > 0) {
280                        ship.setHitpoints(ship.getHitpoints() - hpLoss);
281                        // cause the swarm (or what's left of it) to despawn
282                        if (ship.getHitpoints() <= 0) {
283                                ship.setSpawnDebris(false);
284                                engine.applyDamage(ship, ship.getLocation(), 100f, DamageType.ENERGY, 0f, true, false, missile, false);
285                        }
286                }
287                
288                if (withEMPArc()) {
289                        spawnEMPArc();
290                }
291        }

294

297

300        protected float getHPLossPerTransferredMember() {
301                if (!ship.isFighter()) return 0f;
302                float hpLoss = ship.getMaxHitpoints() / (sourceSwarm.params.baseMembersToMaintain * 0.8f);
303                return hpLoss;
304        }

306        protected void configureMissileSwarmParams(RoilingSwarmParams params) {
307                params.flashFringeColor = new Color(255,50,50,255);
308                params.flashCoreColor = Color.white;
309                params.flashRadius = 60f;
310                params.flashCoreRadiusMult = 0.75f;
311        }

313        protected boolean shouldPickVelocityMatchingPrimaryFragment() {
314                if (missile.getAI() instanceof GuidedMissileAI) {
315                        GuidedMissileAI ai = (GuidedMissileAI) missile.getAI();
316                        if (ai.getTarget() == null) {
317                                return true;
318                        } else {
319                                return false;
320                        }
321                }
322                return true;
323        }

325        protected boolean shouldMakeMissileFaceTargetOnSpawnIfAny() {
326                return false;
327        }

329        protected SwarmMember pickPrimaryFragment() {
330                if (shouldPickVelocityMatchingPrimaryFragment()) {
331                        return pickVelocityMatchingFragmentWithinRange(getRangeFromSourceToPickFragments());
332                }
333                return pickOuterFragmentWithinRange(getRangeFromSourceToPickFragments());
334        }
335        
336        protected SwarmMember pickOuterFragmentWithinRange(float range) {
337                SwarmMember best = null;
338                float maxDist = -Float.MAX_VALUE;
339                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = sourceSwarm.getPicker(true, true);
340                while (!picker.isEmpty()) {
341                        SwarmMember p = picker.pickAndRemove();
342                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(p.loc, sourceSwarm.getAttachedTo().getLocation());
343                        if (sourceSwarm.params.generateOffsetAroundAttachedEntityOval) {
344                                //dist -= sourceSwarm.attachedTo.getCollisionRadius() * 0.75f;
345                                dist -= Misc.getTargetingRadius(p.loc, sourceSwarm.attachedTo, false) + sourceSwarm.params.maxOffset - range * 0.5f;
346                        }
347                        if (dist > maxDist && dist < range) {
348                                best = p;
349                                maxDist = dist;
350                        }
351                }
352                return best;
353        }
354        
355        protected SwarmMember pickVelocityMatchingFragmentWithinRange(float range) {
356                Vector2f vel = missile.getVelocity();
357                SwarmMember best = null;
358                float maxVelDiff = 0f;
359                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = sourceSwarm.getPicker(true, true);
360                while (!picker.isEmpty()) {
361                        SwarmMember p = picker.pickAndRemove();
362                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(p.loc, sourceSwarm.getAttachedTo().getLocation());
363                        if (sourceSwarm.params.generateOffsetAroundAttachedEntityOval) {
364                                dist -= Misc.getTargetingRadius(p.loc, sourceSwarm.attachedTo, false) + sourceSwarm.params.maxOffset - range * 0.5f;
365                        }
366                        float velDiff = Misc.getDistance(p.vel, vel);
367                        if (velDiff > maxVelDiff && dist < range) {
368                                best = p;
369                                maxVelDiff = dist;
370                        }
371                }
372                return best;
373        }
374        
375        protected SwarmMember pickOuterFragmentWithinRangeClosestTo(float range, Vector2f otherLoc) {
376                SwarmMember best = null;
377                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
378                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = sourceSwarm.getPicker(true, true);
379                while (!picker.isEmpty()) {
380                        SwarmMember p = picker.pickAndRemove();
381                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(p.loc, sourceSwarm.getAttachedTo().getLocation());
382                        if (sourceSwarm.params.generateOffsetAroundAttachedEntityOval) {
383                                dist -= Misc.getTargetingRadius(p.loc, sourceSwarm.attachedTo, false) + sourceSwarm.params.maxOffset - range * 0.5f;
384                        }
385                        if (dist > range) continue;
386                        dist = Misc.getDistance(p.loc, otherLoc);
387                        if (dist < minDist) {
388                                best = p;
389                                minDist = dist;
390                        }
391                }
392                return best;
393        }

462        protected void spawnEMPArc() {
463                
464                Vector2f from = weapon.getFirePoint(0);
465                
466                EmpArcParams params = new EmpArcParams();
467                params.segmentLengthMult = 4f;
468
469                params.glowSizeMult = 0.5f;
470                params.brightSpotFadeFraction = 0.33f;
471                params.brightSpotFullFraction = 0.5f;
472                params.movementDurMax = 0.2f;
473                params.flickerRateMult = 0.5f;
474                
475                float dist = Misc.getDistance(from, missile.getLocation());
476                float minBright = 100f;
477                if (dist * params.brightSpotFullFraction < minBright) {
478                        params.brightSpotFullFraction = minBright / Math.max(minBright, dist);
479                }
480                
481                float thickness = 20f;
482                
483                EmpArcEntityAPI arc = engine.spawnEmpArcVisual(from, weapon.getShip(),
484                                   missile.getLocation(),
485                                   missile,
486                                   thickness, // thickness
487                                   getEMPFringeColor(),
488                                   getEMPCoreColor(),
489                                   params
490                                   );
491                //arc.setCoreWidthOverride(thickness * coreWidthMult);
492                arc.setSingleFlickerMode(true);
493                arc.setUpdateFromOffsetEveryFrame(true);
494                //arc.setRenderGlowAtStart(false);
495                //arc.setFadedOutAtStart(true);
496        }
